Distribution. China: Jiangsu (new record), Zhejiang, Fujian, Hubei, Guangxi (new record), Chongqing, Guizhou (new record), Taiwan. In Taiwan, Xenocerogria ruficollis is one of the most common species of Lagriini, especially in the Machilus - Castanopsis zone, including disturbed places and secondary growth.
